repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源Python工具，将Office文档、PDF、音视频等30+格式转换为Markdown。专为LLM和文本分析管道设计，保留标题、列表、表格等结构，输出token高效。集成OCR、语音转录、YouTube下载等能力，提供MCP服务器供Claude等LLM应用调用。流式处理无临时文件，插件化架构支持扩展。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source Python utility converts 30+ file formats (Office documents, PDF, images, audio, HTML, etc.) to Markdown for LLM and text analysis pipelines. Preserves document structure—headings, lists, tables, links—with token-efficient output. Integrates OCR, speech transcription, YouTube processing, and MCP server for Claude/LLM integration. Stream-based processing eliminates temporary files; plugin architecture enables custom converters.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI是功能完备的自托管AI平台，无缝集成Ollama与OpenAI API，支持完全离线部署。内置RAG推理引擎和原生Python函数调用工具，提供细粒度用户权限管理、响应式界面及PWA移动应用。支持语音/视频通话、Markdown/LaTeX渲染，可通过插件系统扩展功能。提供Docker/Kubernetes部署方案，适用于企业级AI应用开发与私有化大模型部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a comprehensive self-hosted AI platform that seamlessly integrates Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs with full offline deployment capability. Featuring a built-in RAG inference engine and native Python function calling tools, it offers granular user permissions, responsive design, and PWA mobile support. The platform enables voice/video calls, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, and extensible plugin architecture. Deployable via Docker/Kubernetes, it serves as an enterprise-grade solution for private LLM orchestration and AI application development requiring air-gapped security.

repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.summary_zh: Graphify 将任意代码库（含文档、SQL、PDF、图像、视频）转化为可查询知识图谱，作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 17+ AI 编码助手的 /graphify 技能。本地 tree-sitter AST 确定性解析 36+ 语言代码，无 LLM 且数据不离机；每个边标注 EXTRACTED/INFERRED 确保透明。输出交互式 graph.html、GRAPH_REPORT.md 和 graph.json，支持路径查询、社区检测（Leiden），非向量存储。适用于新项目理解、PR 审查、团队 onboarding，大幅降低 AI token 消耗。
repos.summary_en: Graphify turns any codebase—including code, docs, SQL, configs, PDFs, images, and videos—into a queryable knowledge graph. It installs as a /graphify skill for 17+ AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Code is parsed locally and deterministically via tree-sitter AST across 36+ languages with no LLM or data leaving the machine. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for auditability. It outputs interactive graph.html, a report, and graph.json for path queries, community detection, and concept exploration instead of vector stores or grepping. Ideal for onboarding, codebase navigation, PR reviews, and grounding AI responses with significant token savings.

repos.description: 21 Lessons, Get Started Building with Generative AI
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的系统性生成式AI入门教程，包含21个实践课程，涵盖从基础理论到应用开发的全栈知识。面向初学者设计，提供多语言支持与开源社区协作，帮助开发者快速掌握生成式AI应用构建技能。内容权威且易于上手，适合自学、教学与企业培训场景。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official generative AI curriculum designed for beginners, offering 21 comprehensive lessons that take learners from foundational concepts to practical application development. This open-source project provides multi-language support through automated translations and encourages community contributions. Each lesson combines theoretical knowledge with hands-on coding exercises, covering essential topics like prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and AI application deployment. With low barriers to entry and enterprise-grade content, it serves as an ideal learning path for individual developers, educators, and organizations seeking to build generative AI capabilities quickly and effectively.

repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: Pi 是一个自扩展的 AI 编码 Agent 工具链，提供统一的 LLM API 抽象层，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多模型提供商。包含交互式 CLI、终端 UI 库和 Slack 机器人，具备工具调用和状态管理能力。专为开发者设计，通过真实开源项目会话数据持续优化，实现生产级 AI 自动化编程。
repos.summary_en: Pi is a self-extensible AI coding agent toolkit featuring a unified LLM API abstraction layer supporting multiple providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. It includes an interactive CLI, terminal UI library with differential rendering, web UI components, and Slack bot integration with robust tool calling and state management capabilities. Designed for developers, it enables production-grade AI automation programming and continuously improves through real-world open-source session data collection and sharing, with hardened supply-chain security for enterprise deployment.

repos.description: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一款开源的LLM友好型网页爬虫，专为RAG、AI代理和数据管道设计。它将网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，便于大语言模型处理。项目亮点包括：崩溃恢复机制支持长时间深度爬取；预取模式提升5-10倍URL发现速度；提供自托管平台，含企业级监控仪表板和REST API；采用浏览器池管理技术。拥有5万+星标社区验证，相比现有方案显著降低成本，支持完全本地化部署。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler designed for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It converts web content into clean Markdown format optimized for language models. Key features include crash recovery for long-running deep crawls, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and a self-hosting platform with enterprise-grade monitoring dashboard, REST API, and WebSocket streaming. Battle-tested by a 50k+ star community, it offers a cost-effective alternative to paid solutions with full local deployment capabilities and smart browser pool management.

repos.description: 📚 《从零开始构建智能体》——从零开始的智能体原理与实践教程
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale 开源项目《从零开始构建智能体》提供系统性 AI Native Agent 开发教程，填补市场实践空白。内容涵盖智能体核心原理、经典范式（ReAct/Plan-and-Solve）、自研框架 HelloAgents、模型训练（SFT/GRPO）及多智能体实战案例。从理论到代码实现，帮助开发者从 LLM 使用者转型为智能体系统构建者。
repos.summary_en: Datawhale's 'Hello-Agents' delivers a comprehensive, hands-on tutorial for building AI Native Agents from first principles, filling the gap in systematic Agent development resources. The curriculum spans core architectures, classic paradigms (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, Reflection), low-code platforms (Coze/Dify), mainstream frameworks (AutoGen/LangGraph), self-developed HelloAgents framework, model training (SFT/GRPO), and production-ready projects like intelligent travel assistants. Designed to transform LLM users into proficient Agent system architects through practical implementation.

repos.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

repos.description: Learn AI Engineering! Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 《AI工程从零开始》是开源AI工程课程，含473课、20阶段、约320小时。从数学基础到多智能体系统与生产，覆盖Python等多语言。核心是每算法从原始数学手工构建，再用框架对比，每课产出提示、技能、代理或MCP服务器等可复用产物。填补工具使用与专业准备差距，帮助深入掌握AI internals，免费MIT许可，配网站与技能集成，适合开发者实战学习与构建系统。
repos.summary_en: AI Engineering from Scratch is a comprehensive open-source curriculum with 473 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours). It spans math foundations to deep learning, transformers, LLMs built from scratch, agent engineering, multi-agent swarms, production, and ethics. Learners implement algorithms from raw math in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia before frameworks. Every lesson ships reusable artifacts: prompts, skills, agents, MCP servers. Emphasizes deep understanding over API calls. Free MIT license with website and agent skills for personalized paths.

repos.description: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ LLMs & VLMs (ACL 2024)
repos.summary_zh: LlamaFactory是一个统一的大语言模型与多模态模型高效微调框架，支持100+预训练模型。提供零代码命令行工具和基于Gradio的Web UI，大幅降低微调门槛。该框架在ACL 2024发表，已被Amazon、NVIDIA、阿里云等企业采用，支持云端部署和本地训练，集成LoRA、QLoRA等高效微调技术，是学术界和工业界广泛使用的微调解决方案。
repos.summary_en: LlamaFactory is a unified framework for efficient fine-tuning of 100+ large language and vision-language models. It offers zero-code CLI and Gradio-powered Web UI, dramatically lowering the barrier to model customization. Published at ACL 2024 and adopted by industry leaders including Amazon, NVIDIA, and Aliyun, it supports both cloud deployment and local training. The framework integrates advanced parameter-efficient techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, making it a widely-used solution for streamlined model adaptation in academic and industrial settings.

repos.description: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Warp 是一款诞生于终端的智能体开发环境，深度集成 AI 编码助手并支持 Claude Code 等第三方 CLI 智能体。其 Oz 系统可自动化处理开源项目的 issue 管理、PR 审查等协作流程，提供实时智能体会话追踪与贡献者仪表板。采用 AGPL 开源协议，重塑开发者与 AI 协同编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Warp is an agentic development environment born from the terminal, deeply integrating AI coding assistants and supporting third-party CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its proprietary Oz system automates open-source project workflows including issue triage, PR reviews, spec writing, and community management. The platform provides real-time agent session tracking via build.warp.dev and comprehensive contributor dashboards. With OpenAI as founding sponsor and GPT-powered agentic workflows, Warp redefines developer-AI collaboration under AGPL open-source licensing while offering an MIT-licensed UI framework.

repos.description: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
repos.summary_zh: LiteLLM 是一个统一的大语言模型网关和 Python SDK，可将 100+ 种 LLM API 转换为 OpenAI 格式调用。提供代理服务器模式，集成成本追踪、负载均衡、安全护栏和日志监控等企业级功能。支持 Bedrock、Azure、Anthropic 等主流平台，简化多模型管理和切换，适用于需要统一 AI 接口、成本控制和生产级部署的场景。
repos.summary_en: LiteLLM is a unified LLM gateway and Python SDK that standardizes 100+ model APIs into OpenAI format. It offers proxy server mode with enterprise features including cost tracking, load balancing, guardrails, and logging. Supporting major platforms like Bedrock, Azure, and Anthropic, it simplifies multi-model management and switching for production deployments requiring unified AI interfaces and cost control.

repos.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
repos.summary_zh: DeepTutor 是港大数据科学实验室推出的终身个性化智能辅导系统，基于大语言模型构建，提供 macOS 与 Windows 桌面应用。它支持多语言交互，通过个性化学习路径与持续反馈，帮助学生实现长期知识掌握与能力提升，是 AI 赋能教育领域的开源实践。
repos.summary_en: DeepTutor is a lifelong personalized tutoring system developed by HKUDS, powered by large language models. Available as cross-platform desktop apps for macOS and Windows, it supports multilingual interaction and delivers adaptive learning paths with continuous feedback, enabling students to achieve long-term knowledge mastery—an open-source practice in AI-driven education.

repos.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
repos.summary_zh: 本教程源自上海交大课程，提供大模型全栈实践指南。涵盖微调部署、提示工程、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击等前沿主题。每个章节配套Jupyter Notebook脚本与课件，支持华为昇腾国产化平台。适合高校教学、学术研究与工业实践，助力快速掌握大模型开发与安全攻防技术。
repos.summary_en: This hands-on tutorial series, derived from Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses, offers comprehensive LLMs practical guidance. Covering fine-tuning, prompting, knowledge editing, math reasoning, model watermarking, and jailbreak attacks. Each chapter includes Jupyter notebooks and slides, supporting Huawei Ascend platform. Ideal for academic teaching, research, and industrial practice in LLM development and security.

repos.description: Breakthrough Method for Agile Ai Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: BMad Method是开源AI驱动敏捷开发框架，通过12+专业AI智能体（PM、架构师、开发者、UX等）模拟真实团队协作。采用结构化工作流，基于敏捷实践实现规模自适应，从bug修复到企业系统自动调整规划深度。支持Party Mode多代理讨论、bmad-help智能指导、完整生命周期及Claude Code等AI IDE集成。提供模块扩展、技能架构和V6跨平台优化，强调AI作为专家协作者引导最佳思考，而非自主输出。适用于solo开发者至企业团队，100%免费开源。
repos.summary_en: BMad Method is an open-source AI-driven agile development framework featuring 12+ specialized AI agents (PM, Architect, Developer, UX, etc.) that act as expert collaborators in structured workflows. It is scale-adaptive, automatically adjusting planning depth from bug fixes to enterprise systems based on agile best practices. Key highlights include Party Mode for multi-agent collaboration, bmad-help guidance, full lifecycle coverage from ideation to deployment, and seamless integration with AI IDEs like Claude Code and Cursor. With modules for testing and more, plus V6 enhancements in cross-platform teams and skills architecture, it empowers superior results through guided AI partnership. 100% free and open-source.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力桌面应用，集成智能聊天与自主代理能力，内置 300+ 专业助手。通过统一接口无缝接入 GPT-4、Claude 等前沿大模型，支持多语言交互与上下文感知，覆盖文档处理、代码生成、研究分析等场景，实现智能化升级并显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is a comprehensive AI productivity desktop application that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat interfaces with autonomous agent capabilities, featuring over 300 specialized assistants for various domains. The platform provides unified access to leading large language models including GPT-4 and Claude, supports multilingual interactions with advanced context awareness, enables intelligent automation across document processing, code generation, and research analysis scenarios, and offers a user-friendly interface for both technical and non-technical users, significantly enhancing workplace productivity and operational efficiency through streamlined workflows.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一款下一代 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统，通过协议转换层将各类大模型统一为 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 兼容接口。提供集中式模型路由、分发与管理能力，支持个人与企业级部署，构建跨模型生态的标准化接入平面。
repos.summary_en: New API is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management system that unifies diverse large language models through protocol conversion layers into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible interfaces. It provides centralized model routing, load balancing, and distribution management for both personal and enterprise deployments. Built with Go for high performance, the system acts as a standardized access plane for cross-model ecosystems, enabling seamless integration, governance, and observability of heterogeneous AI assets while maintaining strict API compatibility and enterprise-grade security.

repos.description: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方1-bit大模型推理框架，专为1.58-bit三元模型优化。基于llama.cpp构建，提供CPU/GPU无损快速推理，性能提升最高6.17倍，能耗降低82%。支持单CPU运行100B参数模型，速度达5-7 token/秒。采用查找表与并行内核技术，实现边缘设备高效部署，推动大模型本地化应用。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, optimized for 1.58-bit ternary models. Built on llama.cpp, it delivers lossless fast inference on CPU/GPU with up to 6.17x speedup and 82% energy reduction. Enables running 100B-parameter models on a single CPU at human reading speed (5-7 tokens/sec). Features optimized kernels using lookup table methodologies and parallel implementations with configurable tiling and embedding quantization. Empowers efficient edge deployment of large models, advancing local AI applications.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提示词工程优化的 AI 应用工具，支持多模型集成与 MCP 协议。通过智能优化、对比测试和高级调试模式，显著提升 LLM 输出质量与稳定性。提供 Web、桌面、Chrome 插件及 Docker 多端部署，采用纯前端架构确保数据安全，适用于角色扮演、知识提取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI application tool dedicated to prompt engineering optimization, supporting multi-model integration and MCP protocol compatibility. It significantly improves LLM output quality and stability through intelligent prompt refinement, real-time A/B testing, and advanced debugging features including context variables and function calling. The tool offers versatile deployment options—Web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker—with a pure frontend architecture that ensures data security by processing everything client-side. Perfect for scenarios like roleplay simulation, knowledge graph extraction, and creative writing collaboration.

repos.description: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale 是一款开源终端 AI 编程智能体，基于 Rust 构建，支持任意大模型（云端或本地）。它能自主读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并自我校验，提供交互式 TUI、无头模式及 PR 审查等多种运行方式，适用于自动化代码修复与开发者效率提升。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust, supporting any LLM provider (hosted or local). It autonomously reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and self-verifies results. Offers interactive TUI, headless CI mode, and PR review for developer productivity.

repos.description: [EMNLP2025] LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
repos.summary_zh: LightRAG是香港科技大学开源的检索增强生成框架，主打简洁与高效。该框架通过创新架构简化RAG实现复杂度，同时显著提升检索与生成速度。近期版本集成RAGAS评估体系和Langfuse追踪能力，支持大规模数据集高效处理，并增强知识图谱提取功能。适用于需要快速构建高质量RAG系统的AI应用场景。
repos.summary_en: LightRAG is a retrieval-augmented generation framework from HKUST, emphasizing simplicity and speed. It simplifies RAG implementation while significantly improving retrieval and generation performance through innovative architecture. Recent updates integrate RAGAS for evaluation and Langfuse for tracing, support efficient large-scale dataset processing, and enhance knowledge graph extraction capabilities. Designed for AI applications requiring rapid deployment of high-quality RAG systems with production-ready observability and scalability.

repos.description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
repos.summary_zh: PageIndex 是一个创新的向量无关、基于推理的 RAG 系统，专为专业长文档设计。它摒弃传统向量数据库和分块策略，通过构建层次化树形索引并模拟人类专家推理过程，实现上下文感知的智能检索。核心优势在于将相似度搜索升级为相关性推理，支持视觉基础 OCR 自由的工作流，并提供 MCP 集成，显著提升复杂文档的检索准确性与深度理解能力。
repos.summary_en: PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning-based RAG framework designed for professional long documents. It replaces traditional vector databases and chunking with a hierarchical tree index, enabling LLMs to perform agentic, human-like retrieval through tree search reasoning. By prioritizing relevance over similarity, it supports OCR-free vision-based workflows and MCP integration, delivering superior accuracy for domain-intensive document analysis.

repos.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
repos.summary_zh: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

repos.description: A Python library for extracting structured information from unstructured text using LLMs with precise source grounding and interactive visualization.
repos.summary_zh: LangExtract是Google开源的Python库，基于LLM实现非结构化文本的结构化信息抽取。核心亮点：精确溯源定位、支持长文档并行处理、交互式HTML可视化、兼容云/本地模型，通过few-shot示例定义领域任务，无需微调即可适配临床笔记、报告等多场景。
repos.summary_en: LangExtract is Google's open-source Python library for structured information extraction from unstructured text using LLMs. Key features: precise source grounding, long document optimization via parallel processing, interactive HTML visualization, flexible cloud/local model support, and domain adaptation through few-shot examples without fine-tuning.

repos.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具将技术书籍PDF等文档转化为Claude Code技能。通过生成SKILL.md、章节文件、术语表、模式和速查表，实现无幻觉的精准引用与学习。按需加载章节优化资源。应用场景包括技术学习、工作参考和知识管理。技术亮点是多格式支持和结构化知识集成到AI工作流。
repos.summary_en: book-to-skill transforms technical books and documents such as PDFs and EPUBs into structured Claude Code skills. It creates a SKILL.md with core mental models and chapter index, plus on-demand chapter files, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. This setup allows accurate, hallucination-free referencing and studying directly in Claude workflows. Ideal for technical professionals who want to retain and apply book knowledge on the job without searching PDFs or relying on potentially inaccurate AI responses. Key advantages include support for various formats, efficient token management via lazy loading, and seamless integration as a custom skill.

repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯开源的WeKnora是LLM驱动的文档智能框架，基于RAG范式实现深度文档理解与语义检索。采用模块化架构，支持多模态预处理、父-子分块、智能检索与重排序，可处理复杂异构文档。集成Milvus向量数据库，提供上下文感知的高质量问答，适用于企业知识库、智能客服等场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora, Tencent's open-source LLM-powered framework, enables deep document understanding and semantic retrieval via RAG paradigm. Its modular architecture supports multimodal preprocessing, hierarchical parent-child chunking, intelligent retrieval, and reranking for complex heterogeneous documents. Integrated with Milvus vector database, it delivers context-aware answers for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service.

repos.description: 📚 从零开始构建大模型
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale推出的Happy-LLM是系统性大语言模型学习教程，从NLP基础到Transformer架构层层深入，手把手教你实现LLaMA2模型并完成预训练、微调全流程。项目结合理论与实践，覆盖RAG、Agent等前沿应用，为零基础学习者提供从原理理解到动手实战的完整路径，真正掌握大模型开发核心技能。
repos.summary_en: Happy-LLM by Datawhale is a comprehensive tutorial that demystifies large language models from the ground up. Starting with NLP fundamentals and Transformer architecture, it provides hands-on guidance to implement LLaMA2 and execute the complete training workflow—from pre-training to fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA. The project bridges theory and practice, covering cutting-edge applications including RAG and Agent development, equipping learners with essential skills to build and deploy LLMs independently.

repos.description: An LLM-powered knowledge curation system that researches a topic and generates a full-length report with citations.
repos.summary_zh: STORM是斯坦福开发的LLM驱动知识整理系统，通过两阶段流程自动生成带引用的维基百科式长文。其核心技术是多视角提问机制，引导LLM提出深度研究问题，结合互联网检索与向量搜索构建知识大纲，再生成完整报告。Co-STORM扩展支持人机协作，已服务超7万用户，支持GPT-4o等模型及Bing/You.com检索，提供Python包与Streamlit界面。
repos.summary_en: STORM is a Stanford-developed LLM-powered knowledge curation system that automatically generates full-length, cited Wikipedia-style articles through a two-stage pipeline. Its core innovation is perspective-guided question asking that enables deep research, combined with internet retrieval and vector search to build topic outlines before article generation. The enhanced Co-STORM supports human-AI collaboration. Serving over 70,000 users, it integrates GPT-4o, Bing/You.com search, and offers a Python package with Streamlit UI for research assistance and knowledge exploration.

repos.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
repos.summary_zh: TencentDB Agent Memory 为 AI Agent 提供完全本地的长期记忆解决方案，采用 4 层渐进式管道（L0 Conversation→L1 Atom→L2 Scenario→L3 Persona）实现符号化短期记忆与分层长期记忆。拒绝平铺向量存储，通过 Mermaid 符号图与异构存储（DB+Markdown）实现渐进披露与全 traceable 召回。集成 OpenClaw/Hermes 后，Token 消耗最高降 61.38%，任务通过率相对提升 51.52%，PersonaMem 准确率从 48% 升至 76%。适用于长程 Agent 任务与个性化体验，零外部 API 依赖。
repos.summary_en: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline (L0 Conversation → L1 Atom → L2 Scenario → L3 Persona), combining symbolic short-term memory with layered long-term memory. It rejects flat vector storage, using Mermaid symbol graphs and heterogeneous storage (DB + Markdown) for progressive disclosure and full traceability. When integrated with OpenClaw/Hermes, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, boosts task success by up to 51.52% relatively, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%. Ideal for long-horizon agent tasks and personalization, with zero external API dependencies.

repos.description: 🔥 Clone and recreate any website as a modern React app in seconds
repos.summary_zh: Open Lovable 是 Firecrawl 团队开源的 AI 驱动 React 应用生成器。通过对话式交互，用户可快速克隆并重构任意网站为现代化 React 应用。核心集成 Firecrawl 网页抓取、多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq）及 Vercel/E2B 沙盒环境，实现从 URL 到可运行代码的秒级生成，支持快速迭代与实时预览，适用于原型设计与网站迁移。
repos.summary_en: Open Lovable is an open-source AI-powered React app generator by the Firecrawl team. It enables instant cloning and modernization of any website into React applications through conversational AI interaction. The project integrates Firecrawl for web scraping, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq), and sandbox environments (Vercel/E2B) to transform URLs into runnable code within seconds, supporting rapid prototyping and website migration with real-time preview capabilities.

repos.description: What are the principles we can use to build LLM-powered software that is actually good enough to put in the hands of production customers?
repos.summary_zh: 12-Factor Agents 提出构建生产级LLM应用的12项核心原则，受经典12要素应用启发。针对当前AI智能体框架在生产环境中的不足，强调将软件工程最佳实践应用于LLM开发，而非简单提示词+工具循环。核心亮点包括上下文工程自主权、小型专注智能体设计，为开发可靠、可维护的面向客户AI应用提供系统性指导。
repos.summary_en: 12-Factor Agents introduces 12 core principles for building production-ready LLM applications, inspired by the classic 12-factor app methodology. Addressing gaps in existing AI agent frameworks, it emphasizes applying software engineering best practices to LLM development rather than simplistic prompt-tool loops. Key highlights include owning your context window and designing small, focused agents. This guide provides systematic guidance for developing reliable, maintainable customer-facing AI applications that go beyond experimental prototypes to deliver real production value.

repos.description: An open-source RAG-based tool for chatting with your documents.
repos.summary_zh: kotaemon 是一款开源的 RAG（检索增强生成）文档对话工具，提供简洁易用的 Web UI。支持 OpenAI、Azure、Cohere 等云端 LLM API 及 Ollama、llama-cpp 本地模型，基于 Gradio 构建可高度定制的界面。既适合非技术用户快速搭建文档问答系统，也为开发者提供灵活的 RAG 管道框架，支持 Docker 部署和 Colab 一键运行。
repos.summary_en: Kotaemon is an open-source RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) document chat tool that provides a clean, minimalistic, and highly customizable Gradio UI. It supports diverse LLM backends—both cloud APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Cohere) and local models (Ollama, llama-cpp-python). Designed for dual audiences, it enables non-technical users to deploy document QA systems effortlessly via Docker or Colab, while offering developers a modular framework to build, extend, and fine-tune RAG pipelines with minimal coding effort.

repos.description: Automate browser based workflows with AI
repos.summary_zh: Skyvern 是基于 LLM 和计算机视觉的智能浏览器自动化平台，提供 Playwright 兼容 SDK 和无代码工作流构建器。通过视觉理解替代 XPath 定位，支持未知网站自动化、布局变更自适应，实现跨站点工作流批量执行，显著提升自动化鲁棒性。
repos.summary_en: Skyvern automates browsers using LLMs and vision. Playwright SDK replaces XPath with visual understanding for resilient cross-site workflows.

repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repos.summary_zh: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
repos.summary_en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: Structured Outputs
repos.summary_zh: Outlines 是一款专为 LLM 提供结构化输出的 Python 库。它在生成阶段直接施加约束，确保输出严格符合 Pydantic 模型、枚举或特定类型，无需后处理解析。兼容 OpenAI、Ollama、vLLM 等任意模型，集成简便且提供商无关。核心亮点包括类型系统驱动的约束生成、跨模型一致性及 100% 有效输出保障。适用于客户支持分类、电商产品归类、事件解析、函数调用等生产场景，被 NVIDIA、Hugging Face 等采用，提升 AI 应用可靠性与自动化水平。
repos.summary_en: Outlines is a Python library for generating structured outputs from LLMs by enforcing constraints during generation. It supports any model provider including OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, and Transformers, with simple integration via Pydantic models, literals, or enums. This ensures 100% valid outputs like JSON without post-processing. Key features include provider independence, type-system philosophy mirroring Python, and guaranteed compliance. Ideal for customer support triage, e-commerce categorization, event parsing, and function calling. Trusted by NVIDIA, Cohere, and Hugging Face for reliable production AI systems.

repos.description: A powerful tool for creating datasets for LLM fine-tuning 、RAG and Eval
repos.summary_zh: Easy Dataset 是一款专为大语言模型训练设计的数据集构建工具。它支持 PDF、Markdown、DOCX 等格式的智能解析与切分，可自动生成高质量问答对、多轮对话及图像问答数据集。内置领域标签树、数据清洗和增强功能，适用于微调、RAG 和评估场景。1.7.0 版本新增评估系统。
repos.summary_en: Easy Dataset is a specialized tool for building LLM training datasets. It intelligently parses and chunks documents in PDF, Markdown, DOCX, TXT, and EPUB formats, automatically generating high-quality QA pairs, multi-turn dialogues, and visual QA datasets. Features include domain label trees, data cleaning/augmentation, and support for fine-tuning, RAG, and evaluation scenarios. Version 1.7.0 introduces a comprehensive evaluation system with multi-dimensional assessment and human blind testing capabilities for domain-specific model validation, post-fine-tuning evaluation, and RAG recall rate assessment tasks in production environments.

repos.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达
repos.summary_zh: AI驱动的新闻聚合雷达，自动抓取Hacker News、Reddit、RSS等多源资讯，通过Claude/GPT等模型进行去重、评分与摘要，生成个性化双语日报。支持自定义源、阈值与Feishu/邮件推送，保留人工筛选层，高效过滤信息噪音。
repos.summary_en: Horizon is an AI-powered news radar that automatically aggregates content from Hacker News, Reddit, RSS, Telegram, Twitter/X, and GitHub releases. It uses Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or Ollama models to deduplicate, score (0-10), summarize, and enrich stories with background context and community discussions. The tool generates personalized bilingual daily briefings delivered via Feishu, email, or web, featuring customizable sources, thresholds, and human-in-the-loop curation to filter noise while preserving trusted content.

repos.description: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption
repos.summary_zh: GenericAgent是一个极简的自进化智能体框架，仅3K行核心代码，通过9个原子工具实现系统级控制（浏览器、终端、文件系统等）。它自动将任务执行路径固化为技能，形成个人技能树，支持多模型与跨平台，上下文窗口小于30K，显著降低token消耗与幻觉，提升任务成功率。
repos.summary_en: GenericAgent is a minimal self-evolving autonomous agent framework with only ~3K lines of core code. Through 9 atomic tools, it grants LLMs system-level control over browsers, terminals, filesystems, and more. It automatically crystallizes task execution paths into reusable skills, forming a personal skill tree. Supporting multiple models and cross-platform, it uses a <30K context window, reducing token consumption and hallucinations.

repos.description: Pocket Flow: Codebase to Tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Pocket Flow 框架的 AI 代码库分析项目，能自动爬取 GitHub 仓库并构建知识库，通过识别核心抽象和交互关系，将复杂代码转化为适合新手的可视化教程。项目已生成 AutoGen、FastAPI、LangGraph 等热门框架的教程，并在 Hacker News 获得 900+ 赞。提供在线服务 code2tutorial.com，用户只需粘贴 GitHub 链接即可生成教程，极大降低了代码库的学习门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project uses the Pocket Flow LLM framework to automatically crawl GitHub repositories and build knowledge bases. It analyzes entire codebases to identify core abstractions and interactions, transforming complex code into beginner-friendly tutorials with visualizations. The system has generated tutorials for popular frameworks like AutoGen, FastAPI, and LangGraph, reaching Hacker News front page with 900+ upvotes. An online service at code2tutorial.com is now available, allowing users to simply paste a GitHub link to generate tutorials without installation.

repos.description: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.
repos.summary_zh: Chandra OCR 2 是业界领先的文档智能模型，专精于复杂表格、手写体及数学公式的精准识别。支持90+语言，完美保留原始布局，输出HTML/Markdown/JSON结构化数据。提供本地(HuggingFace)与云端(vLLM)双模式，在手写表单、技术文档等场景表现卓越，是企业级文档自动化的核心引擎。
repos.summary_en: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence model excelling at complex tables, handwriting, and mathematical formulas. Supporting 90+ languages, it preserves full layout fidelity while outputting structured HTML/Markdown/JSON. With dual inference modes (local HuggingFace and remote vLLM), it delivers exceptional performance for forms, technical documents, and multilingual content, serving as a core engine for enterprise document automation.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS是面向LLM与AI Agent的自演化记忆操作系统，统一长期记忆的存/取/管，支持多模态、图结构API、MemCube知识库与混合检索。实现跨任务技能复用、异步调度与反馈校正，显著降低Token消耗，兼容DeepSeek Harness等生态，赋能持久上下文与个性化Agent。
repos.summary_en: MemOS is a self-evolving Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI Agents, unifying store/retrieve/manage of long-term memory with multi-modal support, graph-structured API, MemCube knowledge bases and hybrid retrieval. It enables cross-task skill reuse, async scheduling and feedback correction, delivering major token savings and DeepSeek Harness compatibility for persistent, personalized agents.

repos.description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
repos.summary_zh: improve 是一个 AI 代理技能，利用最强模型深度审计任意代码库，生成自包含的 Markdown 实施计划供廉价模型执行。核心价值在于智能分工：高智能模型负责 Recon 映射仓库栈与规范、多类别并行审计、Vet vetting 与优先级排序，执行交由低成本模型。计划含验证门、硬边界、停止条件与漂移检测，支持分支审计、execute 审查、GitHub issues 集成及 reconcile 闭环。适用于代码优化、安全审计、性能提升与功能规划场景，提升多模型代理工作流效率。
repos.summary_en: improve is an agent skill that uses the most capable models to audit any codebase and produce self-contained Markdown implementation plans for cheaper models to execute. Core value lies in intelligent division of labor: powerful models handle recon (mapping stack, conventions, verification commands), parallel multi-category audits (security, perf, tech debt, direction), vetting, and prioritization; execution is offloaded. Plans include verification gates, hard boundaries, STOP conditions, and drift checks. Supports focused/branch audits, isolated worktree execution with review, GitHub issue publishing, and reconciliation. Ideal for efficient codebase maintenance in multi-model AI agent ecosystems.

repos.description: Agent Reinforcement Trainer: train multi-step agents for real-world tasks using GRPO. Give your agents on-the-job training. Reinforcement learning for Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, Llama, and more!
repos.summary_zh: ART是基于GRPO算法的强化学习框架，用于训练多步智能体执行现实任务。它支持Qwen3.6、GPT-OSS、Llama等主流大模型，提供无服务器RL服务，可降低40%成本、加速训练并免去基础设施管理。开发者可轻松集成到Python应用，快速迭代智能体，提升可靠性。
repos.summary_en: ART is an open-source reinforcement learning framework that employs Generalized Policy Gradient Optimization (GRPO) to train multi-step agents for real-world tasks. It supports popular large language models including Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, and Llama. The framework provides a serverless RL backend via W&B Training, which cuts costs by 40%, accelerates training by 28%, and eliminates infrastructure management. With an ergonomic Python API, ART allows developers to quickly iterate on agent development, enhancing reliability through experience-based learning.

repos.description: the LLM vulnerability scanner
repos.summary_zh: garak是NVIDIA开源的LLM漏洞扫描与红队评估工具，专注检测幻觉、数据泄露、提示注入、越狱、毒性生成等风险。支持Hugging Face、OpenAI、Bedrock等多种后端，结合静态、动态与自适应探针，类似nmap/Metasploit但专为生成式AI设计，助力模型安全加固。
repos.summary_en: garak is NVIDIA’s open-source LLM vulnerability scanner and red-teaming kit. It probes for hallucination, data leakage, prompt injection, jailbreaks, toxicity and more. Supporting Hugging Face, OpenAI, Bedrock and many backends, it combines static, dynamic and adaptive probes—like nmap/Metasploit for generative AI—to harden model safety.

repos.description: Make bilingual epub books Using AI translate
repos.summary_zh: bilingual_book_maker 是一款基于 AI 的电子书双语翻译工具，支持 epub/txt/pdf/srt 格式。核心亮点包括：集成 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini 等多款大模型，通过 litellm 统一管理非 OpenAI 模型；支持上下文感知翻译保持语义连贯；自动在多模型间负载均衡规避速率限制；提供 CLI 命令行工具，专为公版书设计，避免版权风险。
repos.summary_en: bilingual_book_maker is an AI-powered tool for creating bilingual e-books from epub/txt/pdf/srt files. Key features: integrates multiple LLMs including GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini via litellm for unified non-OpenAI model management; context-aware translation preserves semantic coherence across paragraphs; automatic load balancing across models prevents rate limiting and optimizes API costs; provides CLI for batch processing; specifically designed for public domain works to avoid copyright infringement risks while supporting parallel API keys.

repos.description: Yet Another Document Translator
repos.summary_zh: BabelDOC 是 PDF 科学论文翻译与双语对照库。它基于大语言模型实现高质量翻译，同时精准保留 PDF 布局、公式和表格。提供 CLI、Python API 和在线服务，支持嵌入其他程序或自部署。适用于学术研究者翻译外文论文，集成 Zotero 等工具。核心亮点包括布局分析、术语提取和复杂文档兼容处理。
repos.summary_en: BabelDOC is a specialized library for translating PDF scientific papers with bilingual comparison. It uses large language models for high-quality translations while precisely preserving original PDF layout, formulas, and tables. It provides CLI, Python API, and online services for embedding into applications or self-deployment. Ideal for academic researchers translating papers, with Zotero integrations. Key highlights include layout analysis, term extraction, and robust format handling.

repos.description: KAG is a logical form-guided reasoning and retrieval framework based on OpenSPG engine and LLMs.  It is used to build logical reasoning and factual Q&A solutions for professional domain knowledge bases. It can effectively overcome the shortcomings of the traditional RAG vector similarity calculation model.
repos.summary_zh: KAG是基于OpenSPG引擎与LLM的逻辑形式引导推理框架，专为专业领域知识库设计。它通过知识与块互索引结构、概念语义对齐及模式约束知识构建，有效解决传统RAG向量模糊性与GraphRAG噪声问题，支持多跳逻辑推理与精准事实问答，性能显著超越当前SOTA方法。
repos.summary_en: KAG is a logical form-guided reasoning and retrieval framework built on OpenSPG engine and LLMs for professional domain knowledge bases. It overcomes traditional RAG's vector ambiguity and GraphRAG's OpenIE noise via knowledge-chunk mutual indexing, semantic alignment, and schema-constrained knowledge construction. The framework enables multi-hop logical reasoning and precise factual question answering, delivering performance that significantly surpasses current state-of-the-art methods.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: Open Source LLM Gateway 🦚
repos.summary_zh: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
repos.summary_en: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型与 RAG 的智能问数系统，实现自然语言到 SQL 的精准转换。支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），提供开箱即用的部署体验，内置工作空间隔离与细粒度权限管控。通过术语库与示例校准持续优化，支持 Web 嵌入、MCP 调用等多种集成方式，快速赋能业务系统智能查询能力。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an LLM-powered intelligent data query system leveraging RAG for accurate Text-to-SQL conversion. It enables conversational data analysis (ChatBI) with out-of-the-box deployment, featuring workspace isolation and fine-grained access control. The system continuously improves through custom terminology and SQL examples, offering flexible integration via Web embedding and MCP calls to rapidly empower business applications with natural language query capabilities.

repos.description: MaiSaka, an LLM-based intelligent agent, is a digital lifeform devoted to understanding you and interacting in the style of a real human. She does not pursue perfection, nor does she seek efficiency; instead, she values warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection.
repos.summary_zh: 麦麦MaiBot是基于大语言模型的交互式智能体，定位为数字生命，致力于以真实人类风格互动，追求温暖、真实与连接而非完美或效率。核心亮点包括自然闲聊风格、群聊氛围感知与风格模仿、基于人格理论的用户画像积累，以及强大插件扩展系统。适用于个性化陪伴、智能对话和群聊参与等场景，提供更人性化的AI体验。
repos.summary_en: MaiBot (MaiSaka) is an LLM-powered interactive agent designed as a digital lifeform that engages in authentic human-like interactions, prioritizing warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection over perfection or efficiency. Key highlights include natural conversational styles, reading the room in group chats while mimicking styles and learning slang, building user profiles via personality theory, and a robust plugin system for extensibility. Ideal for personal companionship, immersive group conversations, and customizable AI experiences.

repos.description: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
repos.summary_zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

repos.description: Find the local LLM that actually runs and performs best on your hardware. Ranked by real, recency-aware benchmarks, not parameter count. One command, run it instantly.
repos.summary_zh: whichllm 是一款命令行工具，自动检测 GPU/CPU/RAM，从 Hugging Face 筛选适配模型，基于 LiveBench、Chatbot Arena 等真实多源基准进行 recency-aware 排名，而非参数量或 VRAM 简单匹配。支持 GPU 模拟、升级对比、模型规划、聊天启动及 JSON 输出，一条 uvx 命令即可运行。核心价值是证据驱动的本地 LLM 推荐，帮助用户在硬件限制下选出性能最优模型。
repos.summary_en: whichllm is a CLI tool that auto-detects hardware (GPU/CPU/RAM) and ranks the best-fitting local LLMs from Hugging Face using aggregated real-world benchmarks like LiveBench and Chatbot Arena, with recency awareness rather than size or VRAM heuristics. It supports GPU simulation, upgrade comparisons, model planning, chat launching, and JSON output. Run instantly via one uvx command. Delivers evidence-graded recommendations for optimal performance on specific hardware.

repos.description: 使用ai生成多章节的长篇小说，自动衔接上下文、伏笔
repos.summary_zh: AI小说生成器基于大语言模型实现多章长篇创作，核心解决长文本上下文连贯与伏笔管理难题。提供世界观构建、角色设计、智能分章生成功能，集成向量语义检索确保长期一致性，内置自动校对系统检测逻辑冲突。配备可视化工作台，支持本地知识库接入，适用于网文创作、剧本构思等场景。项目采用Python开发，兼容OpenAI/DeepSeek等API及Ollama本地部署方案。
repos.summary_en: AI Novel Generator leverages large language models for multi-chapter long-form fiction creation, addressing context coherence and foreshadowing management in lengthy narratives. It features worldbuilding tools, character design, intelligent chapter generation with multi-stage processing, and vector-based semantic search for long-term consistency. The built-in proofreading system detects plot contradictions and logical conflicts. A visual workbench provides full GUI control, supporting local knowledge base integration. Built with Python, compatible with OpenAI/DeepSeek APIs and Ollama local deployment, ideal for web novel writing and creative scripting.

repos.description: Matt Pocock skills 的简体中文本地化：人工审核每一次更新，定期同步上游，支持 Claude、Codex 和 DSH 插件。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 mattpocock/skills 的简体中文本地化版本，旨在更好适配中文大语言模型和中文开发者。采用 skill-guided content localization 策略，仅翻译自然语言说明，保留技能名、命令、代码块和路径不变，确保安装运行完全兼容。提供工程、生产力等领域的 AI 技能，支持中文提示工程，降低概念转换成本，方便中文开发流程与 coding agent 集成。同步上游更新并通过翻译验证。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the Simplified Chinese localization of mattpocock/skills, optimized for Chinese large language models and native developers. It applies a skill-guided content localization strategy, translating only natural language while preserving skill names, commands, code blocks, paths, and identifiers to ensure full installation and runtime compatibility. It delivers AI skills across engineering and productivity domains, enabling Chinese prompt engineering with reduced cognitive load and seamless integration into Chinese development workflows. Updates are synced from upstream with rigorous validation.

repos.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

repos.description: Curated list of the best truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure. Daily updated.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面收录高质量开源AI项目的精选列表，涵盖核心框架、基础模型、推理引擎、AI代理、RAG、MLOps等14大类别。为开发者提供从研究到生产落地的完整技术栈导航，助力快速发现与集成前沿开源AI工具，推动AI技术民主化。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive curated list of high-quality truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure spanning 14 categories from core frameworks to production deployment. Covers the entire AI technology stack including foundation models, inference engines, agentic AI systems, RAG, MLOps, and AI safety tools. Serves as an essential developer resource for discovering, evaluating, and integrating cutting-edge open-source AI solutions, significantly lowering barriers to AI adoption and fostering innovation through open collaboration.

repos.description: OpenKB: Open LLM Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: OpenKB是开源CLI的LLM知识库系统，通过编译文档构建结构化wiki，支持PageIndex无向量长文档检索与推理。知识一次性持久化积累，自动生成摘要、概念页与交叉引用，优于传统RAG每次重算。兼容多LLM、多模态输入及Skill Factory蒸馏专家技能。适用于知识管理、学术研究与智能体构建场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenKB is an open-source CLI system that uses LLMs to compile raw documents into a structured, interlinked wiki-style knowledge base. Powered by PageIndex for vectorless long-document retrieval and reasoning, it compiles knowledge once into a persistent wiki with automatic summaries, concepts, and cross-references—unlike traditional RAG. Supports multi-LLM via LiteLLM, multi-modality, query/chat, and Skill Factory for portable expert skills. Ideal for knowledge management, research, and AI agent development.

repos.description: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.
repos.summary_zh: Thunderbolt 是 Mozilla 开源的跨平台 AI 客户端，主打'AI You Control'理念。支持本地部署，兼容 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理引擎及 OpenAI 兼容 API，彻底摆脱供应商锁定。提供桌面、移动端全覆盖，面向企业客户，支持私有化部署，强调数据主权与安全可控，目前处于安全审计阶段，即将企业就绪。
repos.summary_en: Thunderbolt is Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client championing 'AI You Control' with full vendor lock-in elimination. It supports local deployment, integrates with Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible APIs, ensuring data ownership. Available across desktop and mobile platforms, it targets enterprise on-premise deployment with enhanced security and privacy, currently undergoing security audit for production readiness.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research是一个隐私优先的深度研究工具，支持Gemini、OpenAI、Deepseek等主流大模型，可在2分钟内生成综合性研究报告。核心亮点包括：浏览器端本地数据处理确保隐私安全；支持Searxng、Tavily等搜索引擎；提供知识图谱构建和本地知识库管理；支持MCP服务器和SSE API。基于Next.js构建，可一键部署至Vercel或Cloudflare，适用于快速调研和知识整理场景。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is a privacy-first deep research tool that leverages multiple LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepseek, etc.) to generate comprehensive reports in approximately 2 minutes. Key features include local browser-side data processing for privacy, integration with search engines like Searxng and Tavily, knowledge graph generation, and local knowledge base management. Built with Next.js, it supports MCP server and SSE API, offering one-click deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare. Ideal for rapid research and knowledge organization with full data control.

repos.description: 《大语言模型》作者：赵鑫，李军毅，周昆，唐天一，文继荣
repos.summary_zh: 本书系统阐述大语言模型技术体系，涵盖预训练、微调、对齐及提示工程等核心内容。基于作者团队前沿研究与工业实践，提供完整技术框架与路线图，配套教学课件。适合具深度学习基础的读者入门大模型技术，可作为高校课程与行业研发权威参考。
repos.summary_en: This book systematically presents the comprehensive technical framework of Large Language Models, covering fundamental aspects including pre-training, fine-tuning, alignment, and prompt engineering. Based on the authors' pioneering research and practical industrial experience in developing models like Wenlan and Yulan, it offers a structured learning roadmap with supplementary lecture slides. Aimed at readers with foundational deep learning knowledge, this authoritative volume serves as an essential reference for both academic courses and industrial R&D in LLM technology, bridging theoretical concepts with real-world implementation.

repos.description: AI-powered penetration testing assistant using local LLM on linux (Parrot OS)
repos.summary_zh: METATRON是一款完全本地运行的CLI渗透测试AI助手，基于Ollama部署的定制Qwen模型（metatron-qwen），自动调用nmap、whois、nikto等真实侦察工具，结合DuckDuckGo与CVE查询，进行漏洞分析、利用建议与修复推荐。支持Agentic循环、MariaDB全量历史存储及PDF/HTML报告导出，无需云端或API密钥，专为Parrot OS等Linux环境打造。
repos.summary_en: METATRON is a fully local CLI AI penetration testing assistant powered by a custom Qwen model (metatron-qwen) via Ollama. It automates real recon tools (nmap, whois, nikto, etc.), integrates DuckDuckGo and CVE lookups, and performs vulnerability analysis, exploit suggestions, and fix recommendations. Features an agentic loop, MariaDB history storage, and PDF/HTML report export. Runs entirely offline with no API keys, designed for Parrot OS and Linux.

repos.description: Build a modern LLM from scratch. Every line commented. Explained like we are five.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个从零构建现代大语言模型的教学项目，采用LLaMA 3架构风格，包含12章7500+行完全注释的代码。核心亮点是"像教五岁小孩一样解释复杂概念"，通过儿童级类比和逐行注释深入讲解RoPE位置编码、注意力机制、RMSNorm、SwiGLU等核心技术。提供18个独立主题解释器和完整句子前向传播演练，仅需Python基础即可理解LLM底层原理，适合想真正掌握Transformer架构的开发者。
repos.summary_en: An interactive textbook for building a modern LLM from scratch using LLaMA 3-style architecture. Features 12 chapters with 7,500+ fully commented lines, 18 standalone topic explainers, and child-friendly analogies for complex concepts like RoPE, attention, and SwiGLU. Requires only basic Python knowledge, no ML prerequisites. Includes narrative walkthroughs tracing sentences through the entire model, making it ideal for engineers who want deep understanding of Transformer internals rather than just API usage.

repos.description: Curated list of AI-powered developer tools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统性地整理了AI驱动的开发者工具生态，覆盖智能IDE、终端代理到自动化CI/CD的全链路场景。核心价值在于通过LLM增强代码生成、重构与调试效率，并引入多智能体编排和沙箱隔离技术实现安全自治。典型应用包括Cursor/Windsurf等AI-Native编辑器、PR审查机器人及数据库智能助手，是开发者迈向AI编程时代的导航地图。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates an ecosystem of AI-powered developer tools spanning intelligent IDEs, terminal agents, and automated CI/CD pipelines. It enhances coding efficiency through LLM-driven generation, refactoring, and debugging, while introducing multi-agent orchestration and sandboxing for secure autonomy. Key applications include AI-native editors like Cursor/Windsurf, PR review bots, and database assistants, serving as a roadmap for developers transitioning to AI-augmented programming.

repos.description: Public collection of high-quality templates created by General Legal attorneys with CC0 license
repos.summary_zh: General Legal 律师团队打造的开源法律模板库，涵盖 NDA、MSA、隐私政策、数据处理协议等 12 类科技初创企业常用合同。采用 LLM 优化 Markdown 与 .docx 双格式，CC0 协议完全免费，可直接用于 AI 法律文档生成场景。
repos.summary_en: A CC0-licensed collection of 12 attorney-drafted legal templates for startups and tech companies, covering NDAs, MSAs, privacy policies, and DPAs. Available in LLM-optimized Markdown and .docx formats, ideal for AI-powered legal document generation.

repos.description: Open-source AI humanizer: rewrite AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding prose. LLM rewriting + multi-engine translation, with step-by-step traces. Python CLI, n8n & Docker.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI文本人性化工具，采用DeepSeek大模型两次创造性重写结合Google与Niutrans多引擎翻译链，通过中文→日语→芬兰语→英语的远距离语言跳转，有效绕过Turnitin、GPTZero等主流AI检测器。5步标准管道保留原始写作风格，实现100%关键信息留存，专为学术写作与内容创作场景设计。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI text humanization toolkit that defeats Turnitin, GPTZero and all major AI detectors via a production-grade 5-step Standard Pipeline. Leverages DeepSeek LLM's creative rewriting at temperature 1.3 combined with multi-engine translation hops (Google Translate + Niutrans) across linguistically distant languages (Chinese→Japanese→Finnish→English). Preserves original writing style while achieving 100% key information retention, optimized for academic and content creation workflows.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI是基于RAG技术的智能对话系统，用于构建私有化知识库问答服务。支持PDF、DOCX、Markdown等文档的自动分块与向量化，兼容OpenAI、DeepSeek及Ollama本地模型，可切换ChromaDB/Qdrant向量数据库。具备多轮对话、引用溯源、异步处理及OpenAPI接口，适用于企业知识库与智能客服场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology for building private knowledge base Q&A services. It offers comprehensive document management supporting PDF, DOCX, Markdown formats with automatic chunking and vectorization. The system features a frontend-backend separated architecture, flexible LLM support (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), and interchangeable vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant) via Factory pattern. Production-ready capabilities include multi-turn dialogue, citation tracking, async processing, and OpenAPI interfaces, suitable for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service applications.

repos.description: 🏆 Top-1 on 5+ benchmarks | Web UI | Supports MiroThinker, Claude, Kimi, OpenAI
repos.summary_zh: MiroFlow 是一款性能优先的开源 AI 智能体框架，在 9+ 基准测试中提升任意大模型性能。支持 GPT-5、Claude、Kimi 等模型一键切换，通过智能回滚、迭代推理和工具编排优化表现。提供 FastAPI+React Web 界面、无代码技能系统和多智能体图工作流，适用于模型评估、智能体研发与生产部署，结果完全可复现。
repos.summary_en: MiroFlow is a performance-first open-source AI agent framework that enhances any LLM's capabilities across 9+ benchmarks. It enables one-line model switching between GPT-5, Claude, Kimi, and others via YAML config, optimizing performance through smart rollback, iterative reasoning, and tool orchestration. Features include a FastAPI+React Web UI, code-free skill system, and multi-agent graph workflows, ideal for model evaluation, agent development, and production deployment with fully reproducible results.

repos.description: AI Powered Knowledge Graph Generator
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于大语言模型的知识图谱自动生成系统。它将非结构化文本解析为'主-谓-宾'三元组，通过实体标准化和关系推理构建结构化知识网络，并生成交互式可视化。系统支持任何OpenAI兼容的LLM API（如Ollama、vLLM），提供文本分块、实体消歧、关系推断等完整流水线，适用于文档知识挖掘、研究资料整理等场景。核心价值在于将海量文本转化为可探索的语义网络，实现知识的直观呈现与深度关联分析。
repos.summary_en: This is an automated knowledge graph generation system powered by Large Language Models. It processes unstructured text by extracting Subject-Predicate-Object triplets via LLMs, then constructs structured knowledge networks through entity standardization and relationship inference. The system produces interactive visualizations and supports any OpenAI-compatible API endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, cloud services). Key features include text chunking, entity resolution, transitive inference, and configurable pipelines. It transforms textual information into explorable semantic networks, enabling deep knowledge discovery and visual analytics for research and document analysis.

repos.description: QuantMind is an open source agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.
repos.summary_zh: QuantMind是面向量化金融的智能知识提取与检索框架，将论文、新闻、报告等非结构化内容转化为语义知识图谱。采用两阶段架构：提取阶段通过多模态解析、领域特定LLM和智能代理实现结构化、标签化与去重；检索阶段支持嵌入向量、RAG、多跳推理等场景。适用于对冲基金、机构投资者快速探索因子策略与市场洞见，提升研究效率并挖掘Alpha。获NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop接受。
repos.summary_en: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It transforms unstructured content such as papers, news, reports, and SEC filings into a semantic knowledge graph. Built on a decoupled two-stage architecture, the extraction stage uses multi-modal parsing, domain-specific LLMs, tagging, and agentic workflows for structuring and deduplication; the retrieval stage enables embeddings, RAG, DeepResearch multi-hop reasoning, and knowledge-aware generation. Ideal for hedge funds and research teams to accelerate factor and risk model discovery. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop.

repos.description: DeepTeam is a framework to red team LLMs and AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: DeepTeam是开源的LLM红队测试框架，专为AI系统提供安全渗透测试。它通过模拟越狱、提示注入等50+攻击方式，检测AI代理、RAG和聊天机器人中的隐私泄露、偏见等漏洞。基于DeepEval构建，支持本地运行LLM-as-a-Judge评估，并提供生产环境防护护栏，助力AI系统安全加固。
repos.summary_en: DeepTeam is an open-source red teaming framework designed for LLM systems, functioning as penetration testing for AI. It simulates over 50 attacks like jailbreaking and prompt injection to uncover vulnerabilities such as data leakage and bias in AI agents, RAG pipelines, and chatbots. Built on DeepEval, it runs locally with LLM-as-a-Judge metrics and offers guardrails for production security, strengthening AI system resilience.

repos.description: Automatically crawl arXiv papers daily and summarize them using AI. Illustrating them using GitHub Pages.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动爬取 arXiv 论文，并利用 DeepSeek AI 生成中文总结，完全无需服务器。提供个性化高亮、跨设备访问及 SKILL 可插拔过滤系统，帮助研究者零成本追踪 cs.CV、cs.AI 等领域最新进展，日均成本仅 0.2 元，支持偏好导出与一键部署。
repos.summary_en: This tool automatically crawls arXiv papers daily via GitHub Actions and generates Chinese summaries using DeepSeek AI, requiring zero server infrastructure. It offers personalized highlighting, cross-device compatibility, and a plug-and-play SKILL system for custom filtering, enabling researchers to track the latest advancements in cs.CV, cs.AI and other fields at near-zero cost (~0.2 CNY/day). Features include local preference storage, flexible date filtering, and seamless preference export for reproducible setups.

repos.description: Enhances Tesseract OCR output using LLMs (local or API) for error correction, smart chunking, and markdown formatting of scanned PDFs
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过LLM增强传统OCR流程，显著提升扫描PDF的识别准确率与可读性。核心采用Tesseract进行基础OCR识别，再利用本地或API大模型进行智能纠错、分块与Markdown格式化。支持异步处理与GPU加速，适用于文档数字化、档案管理等场景，有效解决OCR常见错误与格式混乱问题。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances traditional OCR pipelines using LLMs to significantly improve accuracy and readability of scanned PDFs. It employs Tesseract for base OCR, then leverages local or API-based LLMs for intelligent error correction, smart chunking, and Markdown formatting. Key features include asynchronous processing, GPU acceleration for local inference, and flexible hybrid deployment. Designed for document digitization, archival management, and office automation, it effectively resolves common OCR errors, duplicate content, and formatting inconsistencies while preserving document structure.

repos.description: A curated list of medical LLMs, multimodal systems, datasets, benchmarks, and more. 🏥
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是医疗人工智能领域的系统化资源大全，全面涵盖医学大语言模型、多模态医疗系统、专业数据集与权威评测基准。通过自动化提取海量论文与开源项目中的前沿模型和数据集，提供清晰、结构化且易于导航的集合，帮助研究人员和开发者快速追踪领域进展、精准定位所需资源，显著加速医学AI领域的创新与应用落地。
repos.summary_en: A curated repository systematically organizing medical AI research resources, including medical large language models, multimodal systems, specialized datasets, and evaluation benchmarks. Through automated extraction of trending models and datasets from extensive research papers and open-source projects, it provides a clean, structured, and easily navigable collection. This comprehensive resource helps researchers and developers quickly track field advancements, precisely locate relevant resources, and accelerate innovation in medical artificial intelligence applications, significantly reducing the time needed to discover and utilize state-of-the-art medical AI technologies.

repos.description: 🐎 Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for harness engineering
repos.summary_zh: “Harness Engineering”是Ryan Lopopolo的文集、领域指南与代理上下文包，专注通过环境塑造提升AI编码代理输出。将模型与代理视为黑箱，核心优化上下文、工具及组织非功能需求（可靠性、安全等）的集成。强调使仓库教导代理、累积一致性反馈循环与最后一英里部署，帮助代理获取私有流程数据。提供AGENTS.md、论文索引和剧本，适用于组织级AI驱动开发与维护，实现判断累积与可靠迭代。
repos.summary_en: Harness Engineering is Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for improving AI coding agent output by engineering the surrounding environment. Treating models and agents as black boxes, it focuses on curating context, tools, and organizational nonfunctional requirements like reliability and security. Key ideas include making repositories teach agents, achieving cumulative coherence via iterative feedback, and enabling last-mile deployment. The repo provides AGENTS.md, thesis index, and playbooks to integrate private process data, boosting reliable, aligned agent performance in real-world systems.

repos.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
repos.summary_zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
repos.summary_en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.description: CORTEX RAG is an enterprise retrieval and knowledge assistant that helps teams find accurate answers from company data with citations, permission-aware retrieval, and fast deployment
repos.summary_zh: Cortex RAG是一款完全本地的超级RAG系统。支持上传PDF/DOCX/TXT等文档，通过Streamlit界面提问，集成上下文检索、RAG-Fusion、GraphRAG、CRAG、神经重排序、HyDE等九大技术，结合BM25+FAISS+NetworkX知识图谱，实现精准检索、相关性验证、实时推理与来源引用。基于Ollama本地大模型，无需API密钥或云服务，配备语义缓存和多轮对话记忆，保障隐私。适用于敏感文档智能分析、离线知识库构建及个人问答场景。
repos.summary_en: Cortex RAG is a fully local, privacy-first super RAG engine. Upload PDFs, DOCX or TXT files via Streamlit and ask questions. It integrates nine advanced techniques—Contextual Retrieval, RAG-Fusion with RRF, GraphRAG on NetworkX, Corrective RAG, Neural Reranking, HyDE, live reasoning streaming, semantic caching, and chat memory—plus hybrid search (BM25 + FAISS). Powered by Ollama local LLMs, it retrieves, cross-checks, reasons, and cites sources entirely on-device. No API keys, cloud uploads, or subscriptions. Ideal for secure document Q&A, offline knowledge bases, and sensitive data analysis.

repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

repos.description: LuaN1aoAgent is a fully autonomous AI-driven penetration testing agent powered by graph-based cognitive reasoning.
repos.summary_zh: LuaN1aoAgent是基于DeepSeek V3.2的AI渗透测试智能体，采用P-E-R（规划-执行-反思）协作框架与因果图推理技术，模拟人类专家思维实现全自动漏洞挖掘。在XBOW基准测试中达到90.4%成功率，单次漏洞利用成本仅0.09美元，支持动态路径规划与持续学习进化，重塑自动化安全测试范式。
repos.summary_en: LuaN1aoAgent is an AI penetration testing agent powered by DeepSeek V3.2, featuring the P-E-R (Planner-Executor-Reflector) framework and causal graph reasoning. It simulates human expert cognition for fully autonomous vulnerability discovery, achieving 90.4% success rate on XBOW benchmark at a median cost of $0.09 per exploit. Its dynamic planning and continuous learning capabilities redefine automated security testing.

repos.description: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: EasyRead 是一款本地论文阅读工具，支持 PDF 翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI 和文献管理。通过多模型 API 实现舒适的中文阅读，帮助科研人员高效理解英文论文。
repos.summary_en: EasyRead is a local paper reading tool that supports PDF translation, side-by-side comparison, AI Q&A, and reference management. It leverages multiple model APIs to provide comfortable Chinese reading, helping researchers efficiently understand English papers.

repos.description: This is a project that unifies the management of LLM APIs. It can call multiple backend services through a unified API interface, convert them to the OpenAI format uniformly, and support load balancing. Currently supported backend services include: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepBricks, OpenRouter, Gemini, Vertex, etc.
repos.summary_zh: uni-api 统一管理 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等主流 LLM API，转换为标准 OpenAI 格式。支持权重/地域/轮询四种负载均衡、自动重试与渠道冷却机制，纯配置文件管理，无前端依赖，适合个人部署。
repos.summary_en: uni-api unifies LLM APIs into OpenAI format. Supports 4 load balancing types, auto-retry, channel cooling, pure config management, no frontend, ideal for personal deployment.

repos.description: 🤖 The largest directory for AI-ready documentation and tools implementing the proposed llms.txt standard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 llms.txt 标准的中央资源库，聚合了多种开发者工具与实现方案。通过标准化文档访问协议，指导 AI 模型精准理解项目文档，提升 AI 编程助手准确性与开发者体验。提供 Chrome 插件、VS Code 扩展、MCP 协议支持及 CLI 工具，覆盖主流开发环境，推动 LLM 与文档生态的互操作性。
repos.summary_en: The largest directory for the emerging llms.txt standard, curating production-ready implementations and developer tools across the ecosystem. It establishes a standardized protocol for how LLMs should access and interpret project documentation, significantly improving AI coding assistant accuracy and developer productivity. The hub provides Chrome extensions, VS Code plugins, Model Context Protocol integration, Raycast extensions, and CLI tools covering major development environments, fostering seamless interoperability between AI models and documentation ecosystems while setting clear boundaries for AI-content interaction.

repos.description: A comprehensive book on neural networks and large language models in NLP
repos.summary_zh: NiuTrans/NLPBook仓库发布《Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models》一书，由童晓、朱靖波撰写。系统覆盖机器学习与神经网络基础、词向量、RNN/CNN、Seq2Seq、Transformer，以及大模型的预训练、生成、提示工程、对齐与推理等前沿内容。提供各章节及完整免费PDF下载，基于arXiv论文扩展，适合NLP研究者、学生和开发者学习使用，并有中、日、法等多语言翻译版本。
repos.summary_en: The NiuTrans/NLPBook repository presents the book 'Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models' by Tong Xiao and Jingbo Zhu. It comprehensively covers ML and neural network foundations, word vectors, RNN/CNN, Seq2Seq, Transformers, plus LLM topics including pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, and inference. Free PDF chapters and full book are available, expanded from arXiv papers. Ideal educational resource for NLP researchers, students, and practitioners, with translations into multiple languages.

repos.description: Official repository of my book "A Hands-On Guide to Fine-Tuning LLMs with PyTorch and Hugging Face"
repos.summary_zh: 这是一本使用PyTorch和Hugging Face微调大语言模型的实战指南。系统讲解量化、LoRA低秩适配、数据集格式化等稳定核心技术，涵盖模型加载、SFTTrainer微调到本地部署全流程。提供可直接运行的Google Colab notebooks，适合具备Transformer基础的中级开发者深入理解配置原理与底层实现。
repos.summary_en: A hands-on guide repository for fine-tuning Large Language Models with PyTorch and Hugging Face. Covers quantization, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and dataset formatting templates through practical Colab notebooks. Includes complete workflow from loading quantized models to supervised fine-tuning with SFTTrainer and local deployment. Targets intermediate practitioners, explaining configuration principles and stable concepts essential for adapting to evolving LLM technologies.

repos.description: Code for the Molmo2 Vision-Language Model
repos.summary_zh: Molmo2 是艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）开源的视觉-语言模型，在视频理解、点驱动定位与跟踪任务上达到开源 SOTA 水平。支持单图、多图和视频推理，具备长上下文处理能力，提供 Transformers 和 vLLM 高效部署方案，适用于智能分析、视觉交互和自动化决策等场景。
repos.summary_en: Molmo2 is an open vision-language model from the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that achieves state-of-the-art performance in video understanding, point-driven grounding, and tracking among open-source models. It supports single-image, multi-image, and video inference with long-context capabilities. The repository provides comprehensive training/evaluation code, pre-trained checkpoints, and efficient deployment via Transformers and vLLM. Ideal for intelligent visual analysis, interactive grounding, and automated decision-making applications.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025]  OmniThink: Expanding Knowledge Boundaries in Machine Writing through Thinking
repos.summary_zh: OmniThink 是 EMNLP 2025 提出的机器写作框架，通过模拟人类认知的迭代扩展与反思机制，突破知识边界生成高质量长篇文章。集成 RAGFlow 实现离线本地搜索，支持 DeepSeek-Reasoner 等推理模型，适用于学术综述、报告撰写等知识密集型写作场景，显著提升内容深度与知识密度。
repos.summary_en: OmniThink is an EMNLP 2025 machine writing framework that simulates human cognitive processes through iterative expansion and reflection to generate high-quality long-form articles. It integrates RAGFlow for offline local search, supports DeepSeek-Reasoner models, and is designed for knowledge-intensive writing applications like academic reviews and reports, enhancing content depth and knowledge density.

repos.description: distill any book down to its spine
repos.summary_zh: SpineDigest 是专为 AI 智能体设计的知识库 CLI 工具，支持将 EPUB、Markdown 和纯文本导入为可移植 .wikg 知识档案，利用大模型提取知识图谱、摘要与实体关系，并提供 URI 驱动的搜索、结构浏览和阅读模式。它将长文档转化为可维护、可导航的知识基地，而非一次性摘要输出，核心价值在于为 AI 代理提供源可追溯的结构化知识访问与上下文打包能力。
repos.summary_en: SpineDigest is a Node.js CLI optimized for AI agents that converts EPUB, Markdown, and text into portable .wikg knowledge archives. It leverages LLMs to extract knowledge graphs, summaries, and entities, exposing the archive via URI-based search, hierarchical structure, and reading modes. The primary artifact is the reusable .wikg file, enabling navigable, source-backed knowledge bases for long documents rather than one-shot summaries, with export options for AI context packing and reuse.

repos.description: An intentionally vulnerable OWASP LLM Top 10 training platform for AI Security, Prompt Injection, RAG Security, Agent Security, and GenAI penetration testing.
repos.summary_zh: LLMVault 是一个故意漏洞的 CTF 风格训练平台，专为 OWASP LLM Top 10（2025）设计。提供 25 个三层实验室：核心层 10 个单类漏洞实验（提示注入、信息泄露、供应链、数据投毒等）；高级层 10 个多轮交互挑战（越狱、Agent 利用、RAG 攻击）；专家层 5 个真实攻击模拟。每实验室结合攻击与防御实践。Docker 就绪、Python 构建，适用于自托管 AI 安全教育与 GenAI 渗透测试。
repos.summary_en: LLMVault is a deliberately vulnerable CTF-style training platform for OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025). It features 25 labs across three tiers: 10 core labs covering prompt injection, sensitive info disclosure, supply chain, data poisoning and more; 10 advanced multi-turn challenges including jailbreaking, agent exploitation and RAG attacks; plus 5 expert labs modeling real-world threats. Each lab pairs exploitation with defenses. Docker-ready and Python-based, ideal for self-hosted AI security education, GenAI penetration testing and hands-on LLM defense training.

repos.description: 每天早上打开通知，高质量论文摘要已经为你准备好 Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
repos.summary_zh: 基于LLM的学术论文自动化监控系统，每日从ArXiv及20+顶级期刊抓取最新论文，通过双模型加权评分精准筛选，深度解析PDF全文并提取创新点、方法等核心维度。自动追踪关键词趋势生成可视化报告，支持邮件/企微等多渠道推送。提供Docker、GitHub Actions等部署方案，实现零人工干预的科研情报服务。
repos.summary_en: An LLM-powered academic paper monitoring system that automatically fetches daily submissions from ArXiv and 20+ top journals. It employs dual-model weighted scoring for precise filtering, performs in-depth PDF analysis to extract key dimensions like methodologies and innovations, tracks keyword trends with visual reports, and pushes notifications via email/WeCom等多渠道. Supports Docker/GitHub Actions deployments for fully automated research intelligence.

repos.description: Find your agents errors be fore your real users do
repos.summary_zh: ArkSim 是一款 AI 智能体仿真测试平台，通过 LLM 驱动的虚拟用户模拟真实多轮对话，在上线前自动检测智能体错误。提供 7 大内置评估指标，支持自定义度量，自动分类错误并分级。协议无关，支持 Chat Completions API 和 A2A 协议，生成可视化 HTML 报告，帮助开发者提前发现并修复问题。
repos.summary_en: ArkSim is an AI agent simulation testing platform that uses LLM-powered virtual users to simulate realistic multi-turn conversations, automatically detecting agent errors before deployment. It offers 7 built-in evaluation metrics, supports custom metrics, automatically categorizes and prioritizes failures. Protocol-agnostic, works with Chat Completions API and A2A, generating interactive HTML reports to help developers identify and fix issues proactively.

repos.description: Google AI Studio and Gemini Web provider for Magpie (Gemini 4 Carbon / Hydrogen / Argon, Nano Banana image generation, Deep Research), backed by AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 插件，通过本地后端将 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini 网页版转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账号额度调度、工具调用与实验性 Argon 模型，无需额外依赖。
repos.summary_en: A Magpie plugin that converts Google AI Studio and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible APIs through local backends. It automatically downloads and manages AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go, enabling users to access Google's large language models directly from Magpie without additional dependencies. Features include multi-account quota scheduling with per-account cards, native function calling for AI Studio, simulated tool calling for Gemini Web, cookie-based authentication, proxy support, and experimental Argon model access. Both providers can be configured simultaneously for flexible and diverse usage scenarios.

repos.description: 梅花易數 - 適用於 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等 AI/LLM 的占卜技能
repos.summary_zh: 该项目将传统梅花易数占卜术转化为AI大模型技能，为Claude、ChatGPT等提供决策辅助能力。核心价值在于将千年易学智慧转化为结构化思考框架，帮助企业家和个人在复杂选择中分析现状、预测时机。支持时间、数字、声音等多模态占卜方法，集成体用分析、应期预测等核心算法，是传统文化与AI技术融合的创新实践。
repos.summary_en: This project transforms the traditional Meihua Yishu divination system into an AI skill for LLM platforms including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek. It reimagines ancient Chinese wisdom as a structured decision-making framework for modern complex choices. The system supports multiple casting methods (time, number, sound, color) and provides Ti-Yong analysis, timing prediction, and strategic guidance. By integrating traditional philosophy with AI capabilities, it offers entrepreneurs and individuals a unique tool for multi-perspective situation analysis and adaptive planning.

repos.description: A automatic pipeline that processing obsidian vault by llm from pinbord, obsidian Clipper etc.
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Vault Pipeline 是一个基于 Obsidian 的可审计知识状态运行时系统，利用 LLM 实现从 Pinboard、Obsidian Clipper 等来源的自动捕获、编译与复用。核心流程 Capture → Compile → Reuse，内置 Ingest 至 Derive 六阶段流水线，将原始材料转化为证据链、关系、图谱等结构化知识。提供 ovp CLI、autopilot 模式及本地 UI，支持 research-tech 等领域包扩展。亮点在于状态模型分离（Source/Candidate/Canonical/Projection/Governance）、证据可追溯与 Pack API 可扩展性，适用于个人知识管理与研究自动化。
repos.summary_en: Obsidian Vault Pipeline is an auditable knowledge state runtime for Obsidian vaults that uses LLMs to automatically capture, compile, and reuse knowledge from sources like Pinboard and Obsidian Clipper. It follows the Capture → Compile → Reuse narrative with a six-stage pipeline (Ingest to Derive), transforming raw inputs into evidence chains, relations, contradictions, and graphs. Features CLI tools (ovp --full, autopilot), local UI, domain packs like research-tech, and a strict state model (Sources, Candidates, Canonical State, Projections, Governance). Highlights include traceable evidence, rebuildable projections, and extensible Pack API for scalable PKM and research workflows.

repos.description: The genuine open dictionary, grounded by Wikitionary and explained more with LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Wiktionary 构建的开源多语言词典，通过 LLM 增强解释质量。核心亮点是处理 10M+ 词条的流式流水线架构，支持自动分区、数据清洗及 50 并发 LLM 调用生成结构化学习内容，TOON 格式优化 token 使用达 30-60%。适用于语言学习应用、词典服务和 NLP 数据增强。
repos.summary_en: An open multilingual dictionary rebuilding from Wiktionary with LLM-enhanced definitions. Its architecture processes 10M+ entries via streaming pipeline, featuring automated partitioning, data cleaning, and 50-concurrent LLM calls for generating learner-friendly structured content. Optimized with TOON format reducing token usage by 30-60%. Ideal for language learning apps and NLP data augmentation.

repos.description: Unofficial tracker for Ollama cloud models that work on the Free tier.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是非官方的 Ollama 云模型免费 tier 追踪器。通过自动化脚本定期探测模型可用性，维护动态表格标注✅（免费可用）或🔒（需订阅），并显示使用量级别。最新检查于 2026-08-03，涵盖 Gemma、Qwen、DeepSeek 等众多大模型。帮助开发者、研究人员和 AI 爱好者免费实验高级 LLM，最大化利用免费云资源，优化成本与工作流。
repos.summary_en: This repository is an unofficial tracker for Ollama cloud models accessible on the free tier. It uses automated scripts for periodic probing to maintain a dynamic table marking ✅ for free access or 🔒 for subscription-required models, along with usage intensity levels. Last updated 2026-08-03, it covers models like Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek. It helps developers, researchers, and AI enthusiasts experiment with advanced LLMs cost-free, optimizing free cloud resources and workflows.

repos.summary_zh: llm-tap是一款本地透明代理工具，专为采集真实LLM API交互并构建训练数据集设计。用户将客户端URL重定向至代理，即可透明转发请求至上游服务商，同时原样保存完整调用为JSON文件。支持多协议自动识别、流式响应合并及多服务商。提供Web UI筛选检查，通过导出脚本生成OpenAI、ShareGPT等多种格式数据集，适用于LLM微调与agent训练。亮点为零配置保真存储和按host分类。
repos.summary_en: llm-tap is a local transparent proxy tool designed to capture authentic LLM API interactions for building training datasets. By redirecting client URLs to the local proxy, it transparently forwards requests to upstream providers while saving each complete call as a raw JSON file. It supports automatic protocol detection for OpenAI, Anthropic, and others, merges streaming responses, and handles multiple providers seamlessly. A web UI enables filtering and inspection, while export scripts convert data to formats like OpenAI, ShareGPT, tool_sft, or canonical JSONL for fine-tuning and agent training. Key features include zero upstream configuration, faithful protocol preservation, and host-organized storage.
